_meta.source_description: 14 WhatsApp screenshots containing Zillow share links and frontal elevation images, read 2026-10-04
_meta.extraction_note: Zillow, Redfin, Realtor, Lennar and newhomesource all return HTTP 403 to direct fetch. Every figure below therefore comes from a web-search snippet, and each carries its own provenance field. Nothing is inferred silently.

price_confidence_levels.confirmed: exact list price appeared verbatim in a search snippet
price_confidence_levels.derived: computed from two published figures (e.g. $/sqft x sqft) and marked as arithmetic, not a quoted price
price_confidence_levels.range_only: only a community or plan-level range was published; the specific home's price is unknown

properties.price_basis: Lakehaven community published as 'Priced From $239,990-$419,990'; a 2,937 sqft Lakehaven spec shown at $329,990 reduced from $334,990, but that is 3509 Eagle Mountain Dr, not this home.
Trulia builder-community page lists '117 Bayou Bend Ct | 4bd 3.5ba 3,075 sqft | $359,900'.
properties.caution: Do not confuse with 117 Bayou Bend BLVD (a different home: Carlsbad plan, 3bd, 2,220 sqft, $334,900).

properties.price_basis: HAR.com agent flyer for MLS 87266577 shows $357,990. Meyerson plan base is published at $327,990+, so this spec carries roughly $30k of upgrades or lot premium.
provenance: redfin.com/TX/Dayton/214-Cross-Gable-Ln-77535/home/198521410 - 'Meyerson plan features 5 bedrooms, 3 baths, an upstairs game room & a study'
properties.caution: The supplied photo (IMG_3491) shows a SINGLE-STOREY elevation, but every source describes the Meyerson as a two-storey plan. The photo and the address disagree - verify which is correct before relying on the elevation.

properties.price_basis: Trulia builder-community page lists '1726 Primrose Pointe Dr | 5bd 4ba 2,813 sqft | $290,990'.
provenance: redfin.com/TX/Crosby/Synova-Majors-Collection/community/46569638 - Lennar masterplan, rec center, trails, playgrounds, parks, lakes
properties.caution: Redfin's $111/sqft against 2,813 sqft implies about $312k, which does not reconcile with $290,990 ($103/sqft). One of the two figures is stale. Treat $290,990 as the list price and re-confirm.

properties.price_basis: Redfin notes 'List price was just lowered by $5K' but no absolute figure appeared in any snippet.
provenance: redfin.com/TX/Cleburne/820-Sugartree-Dr-76031/home/190643207 - 'Built by NHC... Adams plan... Liberty Series... 5 beds 2.5 baths with a Loft AND a flex space AND a Primary bedroom on the main level... over 3000 square feet'
realtor.com/.../820-Sugartree-Dr_Cleburne_TX_76031_M95758-45935 - resale description, newly built deck, all five bedrooms with walk-in closets
properties.caution: This is the only RESALE in the set - originally an October-completion new build (MLS 20608797), now relisted. Different negotiation dynamics and no builder warranty runway. Sqft recorded as 3,000 is a floor ('over 3000'), not an exact measure.

properties.price_basis: Builder's own page states '$289,990 | 5646 Shelford Birch Drive | 5 Beds | 4 Baths 2,776 sq. ft.' Trulia agrees on price and sqft.
provenance: starlighthomes.com/houston/avalon-ridge/pioneer - price, address, beds, baths, sqft (builder-direct, highest confidence)
redfin.com/TX/Cut-and-Shoot/5646-Shelford-Birch-Dr-77303/home/202098467 - 'Pioneer is a spacious two-story home offering 2,776 square feet with 5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms'
properties.caution: Trulia's row for this address says 3ba while the builder and Redfin both say 4ba. Builder-direct figure preferred.

properties.price_basis: No snippet returned this specific address. Snook new-build asking prices seen from $260,990; Grand Lake Classic Collection described as 'coming soon'.
provenance: redfin.com/city/17604/TX/Somerville/5-bedrooms - 'Classic Collection is a new series of single-family homes for sale, coming soon to the Grand Lake masterplan in Snook, TX'
trulia.com/TX/Snook/ - $260,990+ entry point for the market
properties.caution: Least-documented property in the set. Zoned Snook ISD; roughly 20 miles from College Station.

properties.address: Stable View (community-level listing, no street address)
properties.price_basis: The zpid resolves to the Rosemont PLAN page, not a built home. Community range published as $230,500-$323,500.
provenance: zillow.com/community/stable-view/347158307_zpid - 'Rosemont at Stable View... expansive two-story home combines a modern design of 5 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms'
realtor.com/community-detail/Stable-View_102-Stable-View-Drive_Lafayette_LA_70507 - D.R. Horton, minutes from I-49 and I-10
properties.caution: This is a PLAN, not a specific house. There is no fixed price, lot, or completion date to underwrite. Out of state - Louisiana insurance and tax regimes differ materially from Texas.

properties.price_basis: Searches surfaced neighbouring homesites on the same court (6506 Mays, 6510 DiMaggio, 6518 Cobb, 6519 DiMaggio, 6522 Gehrig, 6523 Aaron, 6527 Mays) but not 6515 itself.
provenance: lennar.com/.../needville/monarch-landing6/majors-collection/* - neighbouring homesites confirm builder, community and collection
har.com/flyer/2/mlnum/16181578 - a flyer for this address exists but the snippet carried no price
properties.caution: The supplied photo shows a two-storey brick-and-dark-siding elevation; the Cobb is the Majors two-storey plan (second floor with three bedrooms and a loft), so Cobb is the likely plan - but this is inference, not confirmed.

properties.price_basis: Lennar's page for this exact address exists but returns 403 to direct fetch and the snippet carried no price. Neighbouring Pescarola homes show $122-$125/sqft.
provenance: lennar.com/.../huffman/sila/bristol-coastline-collections/canon/22775515408 - 'Under construction Canon at 722 Pescarola Drive', flex space, covered patio, 'three additional bedrooms surround a versatile game room' on the second floor
properties.caution: Still under construction - completion date unknown, which matters for when rent actually starts. Bed count not established: 'three additional bedrooms' upstairs implies at least 4 total.

properties.address: Crest at Morganfield (community-level listing, no street address)
properties.price_basis: Two different communities of nearly the same name publish different ranges: $233,500-$324,500 (D.R. Horton) and $229,990-$267,990 (DSLD Homes).
provenance: redfin.com/LA/Lake-Charles/Crest-at-Morganfield/community/4148 - attributes to D.R. Horton, '3-4 bedroom homes ranging from 1,447 sqft to 2,079 sqft'
dsldhomes.com/communities/louisiana/lake-charles/the-crest-at-morganfield - DSLD Homes, advertising rates from 3.99% (6.788% APR) on FHA/RD/VA with up to $12,000 toward buydown or closing
properties.caution: Builder identity is genuinely unresolved: 'Crest at Morganfield' (D.R. Horton) and 'The Crest at Morganfield' (DSLD Homes) are both marketed in Lake Charles 70607. Redfin's D.R. Horton range caps at 4 bedrooms / 2,079 sqft, which would fail a 5-bedroom brief outright. Must be resolved before any offer.

properties.price_basis: ARITHMETIC, NOT A QUOTED PRICE: Redfin's $101/sqft x Lennar's published 2,750 sqft = $277,750. Consistent with the collection range $212,990-$288,990. The real list price is probably $277,990 or near it, but no snippet stated it.
provenance: realtor.com/.../109-Peluce-Pl_Caldwell_TX_77836_M90813-42354 - 'new two-story home features a convenient owner's suite on the first floor... An additional bedroom is located off the foyer'
properties.caution: Bed count of 5 is assembled from the layout description (owner's suite on floor one + one bedroom off the foyer + three upstairs), not from a stated '5 bedrooms'. Note also that Redfin lists a DIFFERENT Whitetail Run community in Caldwell built by D.R. Horton (1,321-1,892 sqft) - two builders share the community name, as in Lake Charles.

properties.price_basis: No link, no address, no caption.
properties.caution: IMG_3506 is the only screenshot with NO Zillow link attached - it is a bare builder elevation rendering of a single-storey brick-and-stone home with a side-entry-look two-car garage. It cannot be scored. Identify it or drop it.
